title: Elodie and the Bell
author: Odile Okafor
blurb: Casper Whitlock, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
